headline: Executive order on reducing the power that federal government devices use while in standby mode.
what_it_does: This order deals with devices that keep drawing electricity while switched off or in standby mode. Based on its title, it directs federal agencies to favor energy-efficient standby power devices when they buy equipment. No summary was provided, so specific rules and limits are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to consider standby power use when buying electronic equipment.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell electronics to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: Their products may need to meet energy-efficiency expectations for standby power to win government purchases.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 31, 2001; the specific effective date is not stated in the provided material.
